content: युवन् {%a.%} [यौतीति युवा, यु-कनिन् <ls>Uṇ. 1. 154</ls>] (युवतिः -ती or यूनी {%f.%}; <ab>compar.</ab> यवीयस् or कनीयस्; <ab>superl.</ab> यविष्ठ or कनिष्ठ) .²1 Young, youthful, adult, arrived at puberty. .²2 Strong, healthy. .²3 Excellent, good. --{%m.%} (<ab>nom.</ab> युवा, युवानौ, युवानः, <ab>acc.</ab> <ab>pl.</ab> यूनः, <ab>instr.</ab> <ab>pl.</ab> युवभिः <ab>&c.</ab>) .²1 A young man, a youth; सा यूनि तस्मिन्नभिलाषबन्धं शशाक शालीनतया न वक्तुम् <ls>R. 6. 81</ls>. .²2 A younger descendant (the elder being still alive); जीवति तु वंश्ये युवा <ls>P. IV. 1. 163</ls>, <ls n="P.">I. 2. 65</ls>, <ls n="P.">II. 4. 58</ls>, <ls n="P.">IV. 1. 90</ls>. .²3 An elephant 60 years old. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of a संवत्सर.
